numeric_800x_policy: Values in officially defined continuous rupee/day/count fields are retained as measurements. The same patterns in categorical or binary fields are rejected as unresolved codes.
numeric_9999_policy: Schedule 25.0 defines monetary entries as whole rupees and does not define 9999 as a missing-value sentinel. An exact monetary value of Rs. 9,999 is therefore retained as numeric rather than guessed to be missing.
gender_limitation: The NSS model was trained and evaluated using records coded as Male or Female in the source survey. Other gender-category records were preserved in the source data but excluded from the defined modelling population. Therefore, the model was not validated for excluded gender groups.
